title: Base Azul C2+C3 deep walk + diff review
summary: (C2) Deep walked AnchorStateRegistry (370 LoC), DisputeGameFactory (355), DelayedWETH (130), OptimismPortal2 (674) = 1529 LoC. Found owner-only setImplementation overload-asymmetry in DGF (gameArgs not cleared on no-args overload) but OOS per Immunefi privileged-address rule. (C3) Audited gh PR list on base/contracts: PR #261 OPEN draft 2026-05-04 18:08 UTC adding TDX verifier (feature, not bugfix); PR #264 merged 2026-05-01 removes legacy dispute games + renames ASR IFaultDisputeGame->V2 (interface-only, no logic). All POST-AUDIT diffs analyzed for the Reserve M-02 primary-attack-surface lesson: zero exploitable changes in rc.28 in-scope code.
key_lesson: Differential review on POST-AUDIT-2 PRs surfaced two large iterations: feature-add (TDX) and legacy-removal (-14K lines). Both touched in-scope files but neither introduces a vulnerability path. Active iteration alone does NOT mean a bug exists; inspect the actual diff hunks against the in-scope commit. The 14K-deletion PR was a clean removal of dead code, not a refactor that could leave dangling references.
